note: Eldorado NF campground at 4,900 ft in pine forest on a point on the north shore of Union Valley Reservoir in the Crystal Basin, off Ice House Rd; the paved Union Valley Bike Trail runs along the east shore. The nearest boat ramp is at Yellowjacket. Bear lockers at every site. --Claude
summary: Wolf Creek (Eldorado NF, Union Valley Reservoir): $36 single / $72 double; season late May-late Sept; 22 of 41 family sites reservable, rest FCFS; only ~10 sites take a 40-50 ft rig (FS lists 11 RV sites), the rest 20-25 ft; not waterfront kept (full pool ~65-75 m through forest); phone added; FS website added.
flags: FIT: FS page names only sites 2, 3, 5, 12, 22, 28, 36, 38-40 as 'Tent, Trailer, or R.V.' and the rest 'Tent Site'; recreation.gov allows RV on 40 family sites but lists 20-25 ft on all but 002, 005, 012, 022, 028, 036, 038-041 (40-50 ft). Of those ten, 005, 028, 036 and 038 are reservable. A 23-ft rig fits; trust rec.gov but the FS split disagrees.
